### Balkan Botevgrad vs. ratiopharm ulm (18:00 CET)

##### Ty Harrelson, Ulm head coach

"It's important for us that we manage to win away in the EuroCup. Recently we played better and now we have some players available again. For the standings situation, every win is important to secure a playoff spot in the EuroCup."

### Roma Basketball vs. Bahcesehir College Istanbul (20:00 CET)

##### Alessandro Magro, Roma head coach

"We will begin the second half of the regular season against one of the best teams in Europe. They are currently leading our EuroCup group and sit at the top of the Turkish league standings. They have very talented guards, good-sized bigs, and plenty of experience at the European level. It will be a tough game, but it will also give us the opportunity to react after our last home defeat in Serie A."

##### Kelly Olynyk, Roma forward

"It will be a tough game against a really good team. We need to come out ready to play our style of basketball for the full 40 minutes. It's always great to play in front of our fans. They were fantastic in our last game. Unfortunately, we came up a little bit short, but we're getting better and better, and I'm confident things will turn around."

##### Roma injury report:

Gerald Ayayi is sidelined with an ankle injury.
### Rostock Seawolves vs. Hapoel Midtown Jerusalem (20:00 CET)

##### Przemyslaw Frasunkiewicz, Rostock head coach

"Jerusalem is still unbeaten, both in the domestic league and in the BKT EuroCup. We have no pressure - and you never know how a game will go."

##### Bent Leuchten, Rostock center

"We're going into the game against Jerusalem as underdogs. It's something special to be able to compete against such a strong team with Rostock. We'll give everything to give the fans a great basketball night."

### London Lions vs. Siauliai Basketball (20:30 CET)

##### Tautvydas Sabonis, London Lions head coach

"We’ve got to be disciplined. They are an offensive-minded team. They’ve got a lot of 3pt shooters, a lot of flare screens, back screens. You know, we’ve got to be prepared to be mentally tough and not relax at any moment of the game, especially defensively."

##### Joel Scott, London Lions forward

"We were prideful in what we did \[against Reyer in Round 7\]. We came out ready to play. We knew we were down a little bit with some people out, and we just fought, and that's really all it is. And I think that's going to be the case again tomorrow night. We are going to have to fight and be ready to go."

#### Darius Songaila, Siauliai head coach

"Like always on the road, it's going to be a tough game. We'll have to stick to the game plan and what we've agreed on, and hope we get a chance to fight for the win at the end. I've played here before, back when I represented Zalgiris, and I've watched their other games against Lithuanian teams, so I have no doubt the atmosphere will be great. Our goal is to enjoy it."

#### Selim Fofana, Siauliai guard

"We have to play well on defense and try to stop their transition game. If we play together as a team, we'll have a chance to win."

### Dolomiti Energia Trento vs. Neptunas Klaipeda (20:00 CET)

##### Fabio Bongi, Trento assistant coach

"We certainly need to build on the positive aspects of our recent performances. We are going through a period in which things are not coming as easily as they did at the beginning of the season. We knew this phase would come: we are a team that still needs to grow and gain experience, especially considering the number of new players in the group. We need to be patient. Of course, we need to win games, because that is our goal. However, we must be careful not to let the negative energy generated by defeats turn into stress. Instead, we need to channel that energy into something positive and use it to perform better, starting with our next game. We are facing an opponent we already beat in the first leg, but some time has passed since then and both teams were in a different situation. Neptunas were also still building their team, whereas now they are playing some good basketball. In their last league game, they lost by just a few points on the road against Zalgiris, a EuroLeague team. They have plenty of potential and a clear identity in the way they play. It will be another interesting test. We are absolutely determined to get back to winning ways. I believe the effort the players and everyone in the group are putting in deserves to be rewarded with these two points and a win that we have been missing for a little too long."

##### Darius Brown, Trento guard

"We want to start the second half of the EuroCup season the right way. We already know the team we are going to face, and our goal is to take the court with energy, play our style of basketball and regain consistency. This is a fresh start. We now know all our opponents, and this is the time to bounce back, get back to playing according to our strengths and find the right rhythm heading into the final part of the competition. We managed to beat them in the first leg, but several weeks have passed since then and this will be a different game. We know their players and how they like to play, so we will try to use that knowledge to our advantage, with the aim of getting another win."

##### Trento injury report

Patrick Hassan and Jose Medina Bouza are both ruled out.
